test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 Nov, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

The team won the tournament after weeks of hard work and commitment.

options.text: The tournament had been won by the team after weeks of hard work and commitment.
The tournament was winning by the team after weeks of hard work and commitment.
The tournament was being won by the team after weeks of hard work and commitment.
The tournament was won by the team after weeks of hard work and commitment.

solution:
The option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice is ‘4’ i.e. The tournament was won by the team after weeks of hard work and commitment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence* "The team won the tournament after weeks of hard work and commitment"* is in active voice. In passive voice, the object of the action (the tournament) becomes the subject of the sentence.
 
• Option 4 correctly changes the sentence to passive voice: "The tournament was won by the team after weeks of hard work and commitment."
 
• The other options are incorrect:
 
 
• **Option 1:** Incorrect tense - 'had been won' is past perfect, not simple past.
 
• **Option 2:** Incorrect form - 'was winning' is not appropriate for this context.
 
• **Option 3:** Incorrect continuous tense - 'was being won' does not fit the context.
 
 

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.
